School y: Value = $61, Priority = 1 (highest). This is also a very good option since I have top priority and a good value.
School z: Value = $54, Priority = 2. This is the least attractive option due to low value and low priority.

Comparing w and y, w has a higher value ($72 > $61). Therefore, I prefer w to y.

I want to rank w and y higher than x and z. The exact order of x and z doesn't matter too much since they are both less preferred and have priority 2, but I slightly prefer x to z ($55 > $54).
